labels.label_v1_close_signal_next_open_fill: Signal at session close -> fill at next session's open, both entry and exit; frozen project contract (equivalent in substance to H-20260924-01's own T2 timing).

validation.validation_v1_screen_lane_frozen_windows: screen_lane.py frozen anchor 2024-01-08..2026-09-17 / stress 2016-05-02..2023-09-15 windows, D freq single version (no offset sweep).

costs.cost_v1_10_20bps_next_open: 10bp per side primary, 20bp per side stress, screen_lane.py COST_BPS_PRIMARY/STRESS.

benchmarks.benchmark_v1_letf_vs_s3_k1_k2: K1 (>=80% of S3 median-offset Sharpe both windows, positive 20bp CAGR both windows) / K2 (63-session inverse-vol blend with S3 beats vol-matched S3+SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe both windows), per candidate-manifest.json's keep_rule.

trial_count_and_dsr_note: 12 candidates in this iteration's own screen_batch.py run; n_trials=12 is what leaderboard.json/results.json report. This is a companion iteration to h20260929_01_letf_flow_reversal (15 candidates) -- together the two iterations cover the queue task's full 27-candidate family; see the sibling iteration's candidate-manifest.json for why the split (open_composer/research/iteration_dossier.py's search-space validator caps a single non-campaign-bound path at 24 candidates). The combined 27-candidate family DSR (n_trials=27) and the 24-candidate non-placebo family DSR are computed manually post-hoc and reported in report.md.

keep_rule.K1: date-neutral Sharpe (D freq, single version -- no offset sweep) >= 0.80 * S3's date-neutral Sharpe in BOTH the anchor window (>=1.1882) and the stress window (>=0.6447), at 10bp per side, with positive CAGR at 20bp per side in both windows.
keep_rule.K2: a 63-session trailing-inverse-vol monthly blend of the candidate with S3 beats a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe in BOTH the anchor and stress windows.
keep_rule.watch_recent: anchor-window date-neutral Sharpe >= 1.1882 (K1's anchor bar) but the stress window does not clear its bar -- forward-tracked only, not a keep.
keep_rule.strong_keep: K2 edge >= 0.10 in both windows, or K1's Sharpe in both windows is >= S3's own (1.4853 anchor / 0.8059 stress, exact figures from h20260928_01_s3_rebalance_tranching/results.json).
keep_rule.placebo_internal_falsification: Not applicable in this iteration (no placebo candidates here) -- H-20260924-01's own random-entry-timing placebo result for D1 (real percentile 58-92, short of the 95th-percentile admission bar in every cell) is carried forward as prior evidence in decision-record.md, not recomputed.
keep_rule.multiple_comparisons: This iteration's own leaderboard.json/results.json report n_trials=12. The queue task's instruction to report the full 27-candidate family (jointly with the sibling h20260929_01_letf_flow_reversal iteration) is satisfied by a manual post-hoc DSR computation reported in report.md, not by this field.
